name: splice-equivalence-tests-are-code-only
body:
The splice-equivalence tests exercise code records alone, and the merge e2e always adds code, so the spec-only case stays isolated from them.

rust.splice_e2e.fixture_graph (tests/splice_e2e.rs:21) builds only Module/File/Struct/Function/UnresolvedTarget with code rels. rust.splice_e2e.e2e.delta_application_matches_a_full_rebuild compares code_snapshot alone. rust.splice_e2e.e2e.spliced_and_full_rebuild_agree_on_every_table_count compares every show_tables() count, but on the same code-only fixture both sides carry empty authored tables, so the authored-table equality is vacuous. rust.project_cmd_e2e.e2e.merge_round_trip_start_mutate_verify_merge_rebuild writes Widget and rescans the branch (start_scan_locked(&wt)) before merging, advancing the shared store so the seed guard mismatches.

requirements.requirement.spec-only-splice-equivalence-tests requires a spec-only merge e2e and a spec-only delta test; their test FQNs are forthcoming, declared as planned Implementation nodes with creates tasks at plan time.
